messages.content:
Rewrite these unverified audio-model observations into non-speech captions
for Deaf/hard-of-hearing viewers. These observations are the ONLY factual input;
do not add sounds, source identities, emotion, visuals, plot or interpretations.
Do not treat observations as independently verified. Remove speculative causes
or moods. Preserve multiple audible sound types. Three texts per observation:
essential (short labels), balanced (brief description), detailed (more of the
already supplied acoustic detail, at most 25 words). All <= 278 characters, no
brackets, markup or newlines. If the observation explicitly reports no non-speech
sounds, return null texts for that id. Return only a JSON object with key captions,
an array of objects with EXACT keys id, essential, balanced, detailed. Preserve
every input id exactly once. Do not generate timestamps. Observations:
[{"id": "45", "observation": "A sequence of distinct, non-musical sound effects, including a door opening, a creak, and a brief musical jingle, are audible."}, {"id": "60", "observation": "A brass band plays a lively tune, accompanied by the rhythmic clatter of a typewriter and the soft rustle of paper."}, {"id": "75", "observation": "A choir sings a sustained, ethereal melody, followed by a sharp metallic impact and a brief rustling sound."}, {"id": "90", "observation": "A train whistle sounds, followed by a train horn, and then a train moving on tracks with music playing."}, {"id": "105", "observation": "A solo flute plays a slow, melancholic melody over a sustained string pad, with subtle ambient noise and a faint, high-pitched electronic tone."}, {"id": "120", "observation": "A gentle piano melody plays softly in the background, accompanied by subtle rustling and a distinct thud."}, {"id": "135", "observation": "A door opens, followed by a squeak, a metallic clank, and a brief musical jingle."}, {"id": "150", "observation": "A door opens, followed by a squeak, a door slam, and a person laughing."}]
